description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths.
name: HMD-only pose fix

options.description: Milliseconds added to HMD pose-query time. Tested default: 78 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)

description: Restores the 5001712-era two-layer XR stream topology by skipping underside swapchain creation and submission added in 5002244.
name: Legacy two-layer renderer

description: Forces findBestDecoder() to always select the low-latency hardware decoder (KEY_LOW_LATENCY), reducing decode jitter from ~11 ms median to ≤8 ms on Galaxy XR.
name: Low-latency decoder

description: Matches the Steam Link managed panel to Galaxy XR's combined stereo-display aspect ratio, preventing SDL physical-display metrics from stretching the launcher UI.
name: Managed-panel aspect fix

description: Disables the appear-on-top compositor-overlay path while preserving Android XR input and managed-panel aspect fixes.
name: No overlay permission

description: Replaces VRLink's embedded GLSL fragment shader with configurable Galaxy XR OLED gamma and saturation correction.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Tested profiles: Initial uses gamma 1.06 and saturation 1.12; Final balanced uses gamma 1.20 and saturation 1.45. Custom uses number inputs below.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.06 (Initial) and 1.20 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.12 (Initial) and 1.45 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

description: Adds +16.77 ms to the XrTime argument passed to xrLocateSpace, compensating for the Android XR runtime's local-display prediction being too early for a wireless stream.
name: Pose prediction offset

description: Enables (or disables) the dormant GLSL dither term in VRLink's video fragment shader. Reduces 8-bit contouring on OLED displays.
name: Video dither

options.description: True to uncomment the dither line; false to recomment it.
options.title: Enable dither

description: Directly patches the real SDLSurface.surfaceChanged()/onTouch() and SDLGenericMotionListener_API14.onGenericMotion() method bodies in the original app classes, since the extension DEX merge cannot override methods that already exist there. Applies the managed-panel aspect fix and Galaxy XR pointer routing to the code paths that actually execute.
name: XR direct input & metrics fix

description: Routes Galaxy XR spatial-pointer, controller, and XR_EXT_hand_interaction events to Steam Link launcher mouse/select input.
name: XR launcher input

description: Adds a selectable Pure Black AMOLED theme using Gboard's native color_black theme package, without replacing Dark, Light, System Auto, or Dynamic Color.
name: Add AMOLED Theme

description: Bypasses internal signature check to allow custom APK execution.
name: Allow Modified APK

description: Forces video publish/upload date to remain visible in video author information across all feed types.
name: Always show publish date

description: Strips non-functional build metadata, compiler properties, Kotlin coroutines debug tables, and duplicate license texts from META-INF and APK root.
name: APK Junk Cleaner

description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, and Variations seed fetching.
name: Block Brave Telemetry

description: Neutralizes Sentry crash reporting, Adjust attribution, Facebook AppEvents, Branch referral tracking, and WearOS background sync.
name: Block Hevy Telemetry & Trackers

description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, and crash reporting.
name: Block Telemetry

description: Redirects bifrost.vivaldi.com to 0.0.0.0 in libchrome.so to completely disable Vivaldi account synchronization for an air-gapped experience.
name: Block Vivaldi Sync

description: Blocks Vivaldi usage statistics, crash reporting, Crashpad endpoints, and DirectMatch suggestions.
name: Block Vivaldi Telemetry

description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.
name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer

description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.
name: Brave Origin

description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.
name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization

description: Neutralizes mandatory login walls, dynamic regional forced login gates, and guest browsing restrictions.
name: Bypass Mandatory Login

description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.
name: Clean Share URL

description: Removes sponsored commercial affiliate bookmarks, hides the 3-dot customize button, and disables phantom touch actions on the blank Start Page.
name: Clean Speed Dial Bookmarks

description: Neutralizes on-device machine learning inference (Pitaya), Tako AI chatbot entry points and icons, and AI smart search suggestion clutter.
name: Client-Side AI & Behavioral Profiling Governor

description: Extends unpinned clipboard history retention duration, raises the maximum number of displayed unpinned clips, and allows customizing keyboard grid columns.
name: Clipboard Enhancements

options.description: Maximum number of unpinned clipboard history items to display in the UI (default: 50, range: 5..100).
options.title: Unpinned clip limit

options.description: Number of hours to retain unpinned clips in history before automatic cleanup (e.g. 12, 24 for 1 day, 48 for 2 days, 168 for 7 days. Default: 24).
options.title: Retention time limit (hours)

options.description: Number of columns in the clipboard keyboard layout (1, 2, or 3. Default: 2).
options.title: Clipboard grid columns

description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'clone') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.
name: Clone Gboard

options.description: Suffix appended after the original package name and a dot (e.g. 'clone' -> 'com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.clone').
options.title: Package name suffix

description: Prevents tab restoration on startup, ensuring Vivaldi always opens with a clean Start Page session regardless of how the app was terminated.
name: Close Tabs on Exit

description: Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.
name: Copy comments without username

description: Strips embedded Microblink/FinTech card scanner models, Pitaya AI & ByteNN LLM engines, C2PA origin verification, DLNA cast scanners, and redundant non-Latin fonts to save APK space.
name: Core Asset De-bloat

description: Neutralizes background clipboard snooping routines, local network scanning permissions, and screenshot/recording detection and telemetry listeners to protect user data.
name: Device Privacy Guard

description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.
name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync

description: Prevents Web Background Sync and Periodic Sync APIs from scheduling wakeups and background tasks in Android JobScheduler.
name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync

description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.
name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener

description: Eliminates periodic background wakeups, native library loading, and in-product promotional tips from Chromium tips scheduler.
name: Disable Chromium Tips & Notification Scheduler

description: Disables Google's diagnostic and recovery telemetry.
name: Disable Diagnostics

description: Neutralizes Google Primes performance profiling, jank monitoring, native crash sidecars, and background telemetry threads.
name: Disable Google Primes

description: Neutralizes Mobile Data Download (MDD) periodic background synchronization, automated polling, and prefetch worker tasks while preserving on-demand and user-requested downloads.
name: Disable MDD Background Sync

description: Neutralizes background push notification tasks and persistent socket wake locks to eliminate background battery drain.
name: Disable Push Notifications

description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.
name: Disable Remote Configuration

description: Neutralizes eager background Superpacks synchronization during application startup, eliminating unnecessary disk sweeps and network polling while preserving on-demand pack downloads.
name: Disable Superpacks Eager Sync

description: Disables Tenor GIF selection and share tracking telemetry.
name: Disable Tenor Share Tracking

description: Disables in-app donation prompts, search engine switch promos, rate-app popups, background privacy report alarms, and default browser promotional handlers.
name: Disable Vivaldi Prompts & In-App Popups

description: Neutralizes background WorkManager initialization, database creation, and periodic maintenance workers.
name: Disable WorkManager

description: Strips unselected screen density resource directories from res/ (e.g. drawable-mdpi, drawable-hdpi, mipmap-xhdpi). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and orphan resources are safely preserved.
name: DPI Resource Slimmer

options.description: Comma-separated screen densities to preserve (e.g. 'xxhdpi', 'xhdpi, xxhdpi', 'xxxhdpi'). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and unquantified base directories are always preserved.
options.title: DPI densities to keep

description: Enables the redesigned access points menu bar and customization panel (Panel V2).
name: Enable Access Points Menu Redesign

description: Enables the key border shape selection UI (Default, Semi-rounded, Round) in theme customization.
name: Enable Key Shape Selection

description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You and Following feeds.
name: Feed Ad Blocker

description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You and Following feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), surveys, and mini-drama paywalls.
name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker

description: Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.
name: Feed Live Stream Blocker

description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching by forcing fallback to Web-based OAuth when Google Play Services rejects the modified APK signature.
name: Fix Google login

description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode (disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging) while keeping clipboard functionality enabled.
name: Force Incognito Mode

description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.
name: Hardened Intent Security

description: Disables background WorkManager alarms, periodic job schedulers, Google Play Billing IPC (~89 MB RAM), and removes largeHeap to force aggressive Garbage Collection.
name: Hevy Battery Optimization & Background Sync Killer

description: Strips embedded onboarding MP4 tutorial video, heavy IMG.LY photo editor stickers/textures, and compiler junk metadata.
name: Hevy Resource Slimmer

description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and the TikTok Shop / Mall tab from navigation bars and video posts.
name: Hide TikTok Shop & Mall

description: Redirects external and third-party web links to the default system browser and neutralizes inline JavaScript tracking, DOM monitoring, and AJAX hooking in residual in-app WebViews.
name: In-App Browser Privacy Guard

description: Eliminates cold startup delays, real-time splash advertisements, and background TopView preloading (<0.4s launch).
name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker

description: Strips unselected language string bundles from assets/strings#lang_* to save APK space.
name: Language Pack Purger

options.description: Comma-separated language codes to keep (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English ('en') is always preserved as safe fallback.
options.title: Languages to keep

description: Disables Live 3D gift particle effect engine and widget rendering lifecycle to eliminate frame drops during live streams.
name: Live Stream 3D Gift Optimizer

description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), and live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint.
name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat

description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.
name: Locale PAK Slimmer

options.description: Comma-separated locale codes to keep (e.g. 'es, es-419, en-US, pt-BR, fr, de'). English (en-US) is always kept as a safe fallback.
options.title: Locales to keep

description: Strips unselected language translation directories from res/ (e.g. values-*, raw-*, xml-*). Base fallback resources with no language qualifiers are always preserved.
name: Locale Resource Slimmer

options.description: Comma-separated language codes to preserve (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English fallback is always retained.
options.title: Locales to keep

description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.
name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader

description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.
name: Native Bloat Slimmer

description: Strips background Peer-to-Peer CDN distribution binaries (libavmdlp2pv2.so and libp2plivevdp.so) to prevent battery drain, background data upload, and mesh relay.
name: P2P Video Relay & Mesh CDN Blocker

description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.
name: Playback Speed Persistence

description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.
name: PNG Asset Optimizer

description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads), prevents aggressive video buffer preloading, and caps Fresco animated image memory retention to conserve battery and RAM.
name: Resource & Battery Governor

description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.
name: Resource Slimmer

description: Strips bundled stock wallpapers and sponsored Speed Dial thumbnails to reduce APK size.
name: Resource Slimmer

description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.
name: Show seekbar

description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.
name: SIM Region Selector

options.description: Two-letter ISO country code for SIM and network country spoofing (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'JP', 'GB').
options.title: Spoofed Region ISO Code

description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.
name: Skip First Run

description: Bypasses the entire first-run introduction funnel (interest pickers, swipe tutorials, language prompts, and consent sheets) directly to the feed.
name: Skip First-Launch Onboarding

description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.
name: Studio & Creation De-bloat

description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.
name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer

description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).
name: Unlock Pro

description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.
name: Update Prompt Suppressor

description: Caps maximum video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to reduce GPU/MediaCodec load, lower memory retention, and prevent playback buffering.
name: Video Quality Governor

options.description: Select maximum resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Video Resolution

description: Guards against fatal CompositorView NullPointerException crashes on cold startup and bypasses carrier partner customizations.
name: Vivaldi Startup Performance Optimization

description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.
name: 120 refresh rate

description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.
name: Account sheet cleanup

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, not only Spotify, YouTube Music and Pandora.
name: Any media app

description: Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is shown, and areas already downloaded are drawn on the map. Can be turned off on the Customization screen.
name: Better offline maps

description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
name: Black theme

description: Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.
name: Blue pin

description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.
name: Bypass Play Services checks

description: Sets the launcher and in-app app name.
name: Change app name

options.description: The name shown under the launcher icon and in the app switcher. Left at Ungoogled Maps, Add microG support names the app microG Maps instead.
options.title: App name

description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.
name: Change package name

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name. Left at org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps, Add microG support installs under org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg instead.
options.title: Package name

description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.
name: Customization screen

description: Hides promoted map pins and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.
name: Hide ads and clutter

description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.
name: Legacy icon

description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, Play services is never asked for a location. Play services is never used while it is missing or disabled, so location keeps working on phones without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.
name: Location provider toggle

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: Google Play services' fused provider whenever Play services is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Either can be changed later on the Customization screen.
options.title: Default to Play services location

description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's saved lists and Saved Places.json, several files or the whole Takeout .zip at once). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs. With Add microG support, Maps' own Save keeps syncing to your account and Local saved instead copies the account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account).
name: Offline saved places

description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.
name: Power saving mode

description: Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stops loading. Needs a recent Play services network engine (Cronet); Maps warns when it cannot take the proxy.
name: Proxy

description: Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.
name: Rectangle shapes
